answers.core: Presently, no sort of add-on can affect the filesystem dock context menu, and in order for an add-on to affect how scripts are loaded it would need to entirely replace the ScriptEditorPlugin.
answers.workaround: The workaround is to constantly edit EditorSettings:External/UseExternalEditor, turning it on and off. This is a pain in the ***. This feature would just be a nicety.

title: Allow embedded Script Editor and External Editor concurrently
